about: Narration for the 48 s film. 'at' and 'until' are seconds on the film's clock: the line starts at 'at' and must be over by 'until'. 'text' is what is said; 'say' (optional) is the same line spelt for the speech program (reqochet is said like the word ricochet). Recording your own voice: read 'text', save one file per line as narration/<id>.flac (or .wav), then run sound.mjs.
